widget_prompt: Plot what I paid each calendar day during the current month.

scenes.narration: AgentMeter lets developers sell useful tools to AI agents, with budgets and receipts.
scenes.action: New zero-earning provider, recorded at the start of this same take.

scenes.narration: I register a read-only invoice API, set the price to one cent, and test a synthetic invoice. After testing, I publish its stable MCP name. The example endpoint is free; this demonstrates how a provider meters access.
scenes.action: Actual new draft, connection probe and publication of the same provider-prefixed tool used by Codex.

scenes.narration: The buyer already has four dollars and ninety-one cents of sandbox credit. I choose the newly published one-cent tool.
scenes.action: Show existing $4.91 credit and choose the new tool from the priced catalogue.

scenes.narration: Here I enter a real request into the installed Codex CLI: review three synthetic invoices for at most three cents. Codex calls the registered MCP tool three times and returns the totals and due dates. These are actual CLI logs, streamed to Chrome with private data redacted.
scenes.screen: Official Codex CLI output streamed to Chrome
scenes.action: Retain one continuous normal-speed interval from prompt entry through the three successful MCP calls and model answer. One CLI invocation, no resume or repeated turn.

scenes.narration: Back in AgentMeter, all three calls are settled. The buyer now has four eighty-eight. Every result has a receipt.
scenes.action: The same newly registered tool appears in three new stored receipts; actual balance $4.88.

scenes.narration: The same provider started at zero and earned three cents from these calls. I request a PayPal sandbox payout. Pending funds remain reserved. Once the batch and item succeed, earnings and reserved funds return to zero. The payout receipt remains.
scenes.action: Actual $0.03 earnings → Pay out → SENT hold → SUCCESS and zero balances. Remove the intervening poll wait.

scenes.narration: Reconciliation checks this payout against PayPal. The fresh API receipt agrees. Transaction Search has not reported the new transfer yet, so it stays pending. Fees, gross credit, and net cash remain separate.
scenes.action: Fresh API VERIFIED for this new payout, PENDING_REPORT preserved; three of four total payment-rail records match independent reporting.

scenes.narration: Next I ask for daily spend this month. Real Gemini produces a validated intent. Our custom Studio analyst delegates to the Page agent, which creates the chart and hands back the task. The custom receipt widget and themed Grid show exact money and status cells. This tool has three paid calls. Historical rows are synthetic; analysis never moves funds.
scenes.action: Fresh actual Gemini request, visible model source and Page-agent hand-back, generated chart and custom receipt, then the new tool’s three-call/$0.03 row in themed Grid. Hosted ledger identity unchanged.

scenes.narration: Your tool. Your price. Clear receipts for every successful call. AgentMeter.
scenes.action: New closing capture of the same buyer and $4.88 balance.
